description: Runs a developer-tools vendor's public presence on Stack Overflow - product-tag ownership, staff answering strategy, affiliation disclosure and self-promotion limits, reputation gates, the generative-AI content ban, backlog triage, and canonical self-answered Q&A that ranks in search. Use whenever the user mentions their product tag on Stack Overflow, staff answering there, unanswered questions in their tag, staff answers flagged as spam, or "is Stack Overflow still worth it for our product" - even if they only say "our tag is a mess". Not Stack Internal, ads or the Developer Survey. Do NOT use for getting your own docs cited by AI - use samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-docs-ai-visibility; for docs error pages use samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-troubleshooting-docs.
